Application Data.NAME: Sole Comfort Shoe Repair
Application Data.DESCRIPTION OF OPERATIONS: Sole Comfort Shoe Repair specializes in the retail sale of shoes and comprehensive shoe repair services. Our operations include repairing, refurbishing, and customizing footwear for customers, ensuring high-quality craftsmanship and attention to detail. We maintain a clean, safe, and well-organized storefront, adhering to local safety codes and industry best practices. Our team is trained to provide exceptional customer service while minimizing slip-and-fall hazards through regular floor maintenance. We do not engage in any equipment rental or leasing activities, and our repairs are conducted without the use of hazardous materials. Additionally, we have implemented operational controls to manage risks effectively and ensure customer satisfaction.

Application Data.DESCRIPTION OF LOSSES: On 08/15/2022, a customer reported a slip-and-fall incident in our store due to a wet floor caused by a leaking air conditioning unit. The medical expenses amounted to $2,500. The claim was resolved amicably with no further legal action taken, resulting in a status of closed. Additionally, on 06/10/2023, we incurred a loss of $2,500 for equipment repair due to a broken sewing machine, which was covered under our maintenance plan and is also resolved.
Application Data.HOURS OF OPERATION: Monday to Saturday, 10:00 AM to 6:00 PM
Application Data.OTHER PROTECTION: Security alarm system with 24/7 monitoring and a local watchperson during business hours.
